mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and driven by the absolute level of the rate.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (historical median), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5), or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint strength in the labor market, defined by UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, signals a robust expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 103.0 indicates strong manufacturing and supply chain activity, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 103.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation and aggressive monetary policy (CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising interest rates and inflationary pressures depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5), or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
